lcc_original: 永恆主上帝使各樣的樹從土地裏長起來：看了可喜愛，做食品好喫。園子當中又有生命樹和知識樹，能使人分別善惡【6】。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (WH03068); 上帝 is LCC's rendering of אֱלֹהִים (WH0430) vs UNV 耶和華/神
使…長起來 is the Hiphil of צָמַח: 使 receives WH06779+WH00 (causative + null particle) and 長起來 receives WH06779+WTH8686 (verb + Hiphil morphology), mirroring UNV's split-causative tagging
LCC restructures 可以悅人的眼目 (נֶחְמָד לְמַרְאֶה) into 看了可喜愛: 看了 maps to לְמַרְאֶה (WAH09001+WH04758), 可喜愛 maps to נֶחְמָד Niphal ptcp (WH02530+WTH8737)
LCC omits 其上的果子 (no SN in UNV either); 做食品好喫 maps טוֹב לְמַאֲכָל: 做食品 = לְמַאֲכָל (WAH09001+WH03978), 好 = טוֹב (WH02896); 喫 is unannotated (LCC addition)
LCC adds the explanatory relative clause 能使人分別 for the tree of knowledge; 分別 in this clause is left untagged as LCC's expansion; 知識 receives WH01847 (דַּעַת)
WH02896 (טוֹב) correctly appears twice: 好 in the food clause and 善 in the good-evil pair
